claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children

risks.risk: Dead keys or inconsistent key response may exist even if some keys work.
risks.proof: Video of power-on + playing every key across the full range (or key-test mode) with audible output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may have dead keys / not fully working.

risks.risk: Buttons/sliders may be intermittent or not responding correctly.
risks.proof: Video showing multiple different buttons and at least 2–3 sliders changing sounds/settings with audible/visible effect.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may have non-working controls.

risks.risk: Adapter may be missing or incorrect (wrong voltage/plug), so the keyboard may not power reliably.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter label (voltage/amp) + video of keyboard powering on using it.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as adapter not confirmed / may not power.

risks.risk: Speaker crackle or headphone output fault not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Short audio clip while playing at low and medium volume; also test headphone output if available.

risks.risk: Exact Yamaha model number not confirmed; pricing depends on the specific model/features.
risks.proof: Photo of the back/bottom label with model number (or clearly readable model text).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest likely tier for a Yamaha keyboard without confirmed model.

proof_requests: Photo of the back/bottom label showing the exact Yamaha model number.
Video: power-on + full-range key test (or key-test mode) with audible output.
Video: demonstrate several buttons and sliders with visible/audible changes.
Photo of the adapter label and a video of the keyboard powering on using it.
Audio clip showing speaker output (low + medium volume) to confirm no crackle.
response.reason: The seller’s claim of testing is not supported by any new remote evidence. Without power-on/audio and key/button test proof, the worst-case pricing cannot be set reliably.
